# [ProfitPilot](https://profitpilotio.vercel.app/)
> AI-Driven Retail Management Platform for Indian MSMEs, engineered by [Bhvya Vaish](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhvya-vaish/).

## Overview
ProfitPilot is a modern cloud application built to empower small business owners across India. It integrates inventory control, GST-compliant invoicing, live business health analytics, tax regime estimators, and a localized AI business assistant.
